about_the_game:
Luminest is a healing 2D platformer where you embody Luminest, a healing spirit, exploring fragmented lands shrouded in darkness. Help lost souls rediscover warmth and courage, dispel the world’s darkness, and embark on a heartwarming journey of self-acceptance and spiritual growth.

Key Features:

  • Explore while in flight: Search every nook and cranny for crucial clues and items to progress.

  • Encounter and interact with diverse insects and animals to unlock the unknown touching stories deep in the forest.

  • Therapeutic audio ambiance: Lose yourself in calming music that lets you focus and savor the journey.

  • Dual difficulty modes: Choose between "Relaxing Healing" for a laid-back experience or "Challenging Adventure" for a more thrilling quest.

  • Music-driven puzzles: Sound becomes an integral part of the gameplay, with musical elements central to solving mysteries.

  • Hand-painted watercolor art: Experience vivid, lifelike visuals that breathe magic into the game’s whimsical world.

Venture through the dark forest in pursuit of faint glimmers of light. Let the ethereal music and imaginative world guide you as you explore and uncover the tales hidden within.
detailed_description:
Game Renaming Notice

Dear Players, due to some copyright review issues, the original game name "Tolampis" has been changed to "Luminest". The game will retain all the elements you love, and the player character has been upgraded from a firefly to a firefly spirit. We hope you enjoy this update and continue to support our game. Thank you!
